comment_short: Hospital is the named confounder but is absent from the primary PS model
action_taken: Acknowledged; TMLE does adjust for site. Refitting the primary model with site is out of scope for this staging run and is recorded as open.

comment_short: 26.6% unmatched attributed to common support; arithmetic (962 treated vs 838 controls) explains most of it
action_taken: Open — flagged for revision; the 132 unused controls are also unreported.

comment_short: 'Order-independent' conflated with 'reproducible'
action_taken: Methods rewritten: fixed order gives reproducibility, not invariance; tie behaviour and its 0.577-0.579 effect now stated.

comment_short: Proportional hazards never tested; Schoenfeld p = 0.035
Limitation 4 asserts CIs are narrow; pair-clustered SE is actually smaller
Specification curve pools conditional, ATE and ATT estimands into one median
IPCW uses a marginal censoring KM; never stated

action_taken: Genuine, but the synthetic generator does not contain these fields. Belongs in Limitations.

comment_short: 88.5% of matched pairs cross hospitals
action_taken: Open — same root cause as R1-1.

comment_short: Varices treated as exchangeable confounder, not as a bevacizumab contraindication
action_taken: Correct clinically; the dataset has no bleeding endpoint. Recorded as a data limitation.

comment_short: No safety or response data reported although the fields exist
action_taken: Open — response and grade 3-4 AE fields are in pooled.csv and should be reported.

comment_short: Median OS quoted beyond supportable follow-up; no RMST, no NNT

Subgroups omit liver function and varices strata
STROBE 14a: no Table 1 anywhere in the manuscript
action_taken: Open — the largest single reporting gap.

comment_short: STROBE 13: no flow diagram; 132 discarded controls never mentioned
